answer.cause: angleDiff() wrapped angles only for d > 180 and lacked the d < -180 branch, so a mark to starboard whose bearing-minus-heading fell below -180 (e.g. bearing -41 deg at heading 213 deg) produced rudder -1, turning the long way round to port.
